A big thank you to **Perfect Decor** for transforming our venue into a beautifully decorated space for our morning event! The setup was elegant, fresh, and perfectly suited to the occasion. Our guests were full of compliments and truly loved the ambience.

**A special thanks to Nitin Bhai**, the owner, for his personal touch and hands-on involvement — it truly made all the difference. Your attention to detail and creative flair played a big role in making our event a grand success. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: SD
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Perfect Decor for my wedding, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the experience! From start to finish, Nitin bhai and his amazing team went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and dedication to our vision were truly outstanding.
Nitin bhai and Kaushik was always available to answer questions and provided valuable guidance throughout the entire planning process. On the big day, the decorations were absolutely stunning and exceeded all of our expectations. Every element, from the mandap to the floral arrangements, was meticulously arranged and aligned with our traditions and personal style.
The team made sure everything ran smoothly and that all of our requests were met with a smile. I felt completely at ease knowing I could trust them to handle all the details while I enjoyed the most important day of my life.
If you're looking for a team that is reliable, creative, and passionate about making your event unforgettable, I highly recommend Perfect Decor. Thank you, Nitin bhai, Kaushik and the entire team for making our wedding day magical!

featured_reviews.review_text: Nitin Bhai is a very nice person to work with. He customised decoration as per your likings and requirements. Very systematic . featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so very much. for your kind words & observations. Regards :)

featured_reviews.review_text: Decoration on our wedding day (21st May 2022) was very beautifully done. The colour combination was taken care of exactly as per our preference and request. featured_reviews.name: Joshua Varghese
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Perfect Decor Team had the perfect Balance of a Professional approach and a personal touch that we would require for our important Occasion.
In my personal Experience:
Pro:
1. Open to inputs and supports with prompt revisions, even with last minute modifications.
2. Adds practical and value recommendations to make the design a reality.
3. Excellent execution - The decoration could not have been more on point with the references. We were especially impressed with the work they did on the Photobooth.
4. Provided Additional Support - They were helpful in providing materials which even fell out of their scope.
.
Cons:
These can't really count as cons, but.. for the sake of naming cons..
1. A major chunk of the Payments would be in advance. This was anyways pre-agreed to.
2. One of the Pyros did not fire.. so can't call it a flawless execution. (I did say I would have to nitpick for cons)
.
Overall
I will definitely recommend them for those planning a wedding. They delivered more than our expectations.

featured_reviews.name: Rehan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Wedding Venue Experience – Absolute Mismanagement and Broken Promises

If I could give Sawai Banquet Hall zero stars, I would.

What was supposed to be one of the most important and memorable days of our lives turned into a stressful and frustrating experience because of the venue's complete lack of professionalism, planning, and accountability. The management made countless promises before taking our booking, but when it came time to deliver, they failed on almost every front.

We were explicitly assured that the afternoon event would end by 4:30 PM and that all the venues we had booked Sawai Banquet, Tiara, Ahana, and Vatika  would be fully handed over by 5:30 PM. However, when we arrived at 6:15 PM, the previous event's guests were still vacating the premises. The venue was nowhere close to being ready. Decorations had not been completed, arrangements were unfinished, and there was complete chaos instead of preparation.

The bridal room was another disappointment. The air conditioning was not working, making it extremely uncomfortable for the bride and family members during an already hectic schedule.

The washrooms were dirty, unhygienic, and clearly had not been cleaned properly despite repeated assurances regarding venue cleanliness. For a premium wedding venue, this level of neglect is simply unacceptable.

Several arrangements that were specifically promised during discussions were never provided. Direction boards for the Veg and Non-Veg food sections were missing. The Nikah setup was not arranged as committed. Guests were left confused and inconvenienced due to the lack of basic event coordination.

The situation only worsened during the reception. Even by 8:00 PM, the special reception entry that had been promised was still not ready. Chairs and sofas were covered in dust and looked as though they had not been cleaned before guests arrived. It was embarrassing to host guests under such conditions.

Parking arrangements were another complete failure. We were charged for parking facilities for approximately 30 vehicles and were informed that the venue had a tie-up with Amar Theatre to accommodate additional parking. On the wedding day, we were suddenly informed that the theatre was undergoing demolition and no parking was available. No alternative arrangements were made, leaving our guests to struggle unnecessarily.

What is most disappointing is not just the poor execution, but the complete gap between what was promised and what was delivered. The management seems far more interested in making commitments during the sales process than actually fulfilling them on the event day.

This venue excels at making promises and fails at keeping them.

Our wedding day should have been filled with joy and celebration. Instead, we spent hours dealing with delays, missing arrangements, poor cleanliness, and management failures.

I would strongly advise anyone planning a wedding or major event to avoid Sawai Banquet Hall unless they are prepared for last-minute surprises, broken commitments, and unnecessary stress.

Tall promises. Zero delivery. Zero accountability. Absolutely not recommended.
